description: Return the bounding box (CSS pixels) of the element identified by ref or selector. Returns: { ok, session_id, bbox: { x, y, w, h } }. Errors: REF_NOT_FOUND / SELECTOR_NO_MATCH (carries similar_refs), TRANSPORT_UNSUPPORTED, NOT_RUNNING, BAD_ARGUMENT.

ref.description: Element ref from a snapshot (resolves to [data-sw-ref="N"]). Provide ref OR selector.

selector.description: CSS selector. Provide ref OR selector, not both.

sessionId.description: Target session id. Omit when a single session is running.

name: electron_get_bbox
title: Get an element’s bounding box
